FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Comprehension.

2. When practising Listening for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Comprehension.

3. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.

4. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.

5. When practising Reading for Vocabulary, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Vocabulary.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Vocabulary.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Vocabulary.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Vocabulary.

6. “Bonjour” is used to say: (1 mark)
   A. Good morning / hello
   B. Good night only
   C. Thank you
   D. Excuse me

7. When practising Grammar, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Grammar.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Grammar.

8. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.

9. The French word for “book” is: (1 mark)
   A. porte
   B. chaise
   C. livre
   D. fenêtre

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
